north_star: 持续提升 RCL 作为可执行现实语义中间语言/现实事务演算的通用性、可表达性、可执行性、可验证性与现实鲁棒性；候选现实不得绕过证据、权限、版本、4R 与现实验证边界。

observations.signal: RCL declares the four 4R controls and produces foundation_governance for RNCS, but RCL itself has no reusable commit-grade 4R gate; its own conformance report therefore keeps 4R controls partial.
Declared Foundation-domain syntax remains outside the Native VM bytecode subset and is executed through provider bridges.
The self-host compiler is strong but Stage-0 JavaScript still owns parts of serialization/host materialization, so whole-language native closure remains bounded.

ranked_candidates.problem: make RCL itself fail closed on incomplete provider capability, authority, evidence, invariant and irreversible-effect governance instead of only declaring 4R artifacts or relying on RNCS downstream
lower declared Foundation-domain syntax directly into the native bytecode/runtime path
remove remaining Stage-0 host ownership from whole-language self-host closure

mode_reason: multiple high-pressure domains remain coupled and the top two candidates are close in North Star score; add the missing governance organ across structural validation, commit decision and RNCS handoff before deeper local lowering work

targeted_local.command: node --test tests/foundation-governance-gate.test.mjs (materialized candidate module with the current Foundation contract version)

truth_boundary: This cycle proves a deterministic RCL-owned 4R governance gate and structural gating of RCL->RNCS proposal handoff. It does not claim declared Foundation-domain syntax is native VM syntax, nor that the repository-wide suite has been rerun.
